dummyLine = input()
inputLine = input()

maxLength = 0
totalTokens = 0
position = 0
lastPosition = 0

while position < inputLine.rfind(')'):
    startIdx = inputLine.find('(', position)
    endIdx = inputLine.find(')', startIdx)
    segment = inputLine[lastPosition:startIdx]
    for token in segment.split('_'):
        length = len(token)
        if length > maxLength:
            maxLength = length
    insideContent = inputLine[startIdx + 1:endIdx]
    for token in insideContent.split('_'):
        if token:
            totalTokens += 1
    lastPosition = endIdx + 1
    position = endIdx

remainingPart = inputLine[lastPosition:]
for token in remainingPart.split('_'):
    length = len(token)
    if length > maxLength:
        maxLength = length

print(f"{maxLength} {totalTokens}")
